notes.ad_press_omits_settle: agent-device 0.21.2 native .ad press/fill parser joins leftover --settle into the selector; --settle is CLI-only. Replay still waits for the next wait landmark.

cases.title: 系统选图进入编辑器
cases.honesty: Android uses batch JSON, not .ad: Photo Picker cells have no filename and native .ad turns find --first into a positional, so replay hits AMBIGUOUS_MATCH. Batch find first:true clicks the first 照片拍摄于 recent (home setup just pushed fixtures), then 完成, then editor Save. Drive stays seam. zh-CN picker labels. Replay/batch pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 系统分享输入进入编辑器

reason.ios: map.yaml ios.drive is none; ACTION_SEND share-in is Android-only.

cases.honesty: Android harness share-in (ACTION_SEND) is the entry; the script does not relaunch and does not walk a picker. That does not rewrite drive.

cases.title: 启动页往返关于
cases.honesty: Launch-class open uses --relaunch. iOS scripts ignore store-seed-* nodes and wait for visible Choose Images / About / Version / Back. A leftover editor session after About Back is product state, reported as REPLAY_DIVERGENCE, not minted as human confirmation.

cases.title: 编辑器往返关于并保留内容
cases.honesty: Requires harness editor setup (Android ACTION_SEND / iOS editor session). Script must not --relaunch. About must be opened from the editor, not Launch.

cases.title: 内置图库选图

reason.ios: map.yaml ios.drive is none; in-app gallery is Android-only.

cases.honesty: Android script toggles Use in-app gallery from About; the toggle is not restored. A system permission dialog remains seam and does not upgrade drive.

cases.title: 模板新增、应用和删除
cases.honesty: Create/apply use a unique env TEMPLATE string. Multiple Delete buttons share a label, so the script does not press Delete; only this-run content is asserted. Do not assume an empty template list.

cases.title: 文字编辑与真实导出
cases.honesty: Exact watermark text is env WATERMARK. Export file checks stay in the runner ingest layer. Replay pass is not product pass.

cases.title: 自定义颜色确认与回读

reason.android: Android native color wheel has no durable label/id/role; coordinates are forbidden.

cases.honesty: Android script only opens the custom swatch and waits. iOS fills the hex field. Do not claim RGB 00AABB from an unlabeled wheel. Historical round-2 result.json stays failed; file-recheck is a separate audit.

cases.title: 导出面板格式切换与取消
cases.honesty: UI round-trip only: JPEG then PNG, no export. close ends the session; it is not a product cancel proof by itself.

cases.title: 图片水印系统选择器

reason.android: Icon picker destination is system UI; picker cells have no durable selector.
reason.ios: PhotosPicker grid cells are not addressable; PUPicker cells are not durable selectors.

cases.honesty: Scripts only open the in-app Icon / Choose picture control and wait. System picker cells are not tapped. Drive stays none/seam.

cases.title: 继续加图与两张批量导出
cases.honesty: supported true for execution. Business remains failed for historical run 20260912T140000-000c3f44 until independent review of a new run. Do not auto-fail new runs. Append via system picker stays seam/none and does not upgrade drive. Replay pass is not product pass; do not mint human confirmation.

cases.title: PNG 保存完成与文件验收
cases.honesty: In-app Save / PNG / Export only. Photos permission and album write are seam. File checks belong to script_checks, not agent_observation. Replay pass is not product pass.

cases.title: 导出后打开系统面板
cases.honesty: If Share is visible the script opens it and stops; it does not pick a recipient. View in gallery is not a share sheet. System chooser stays seam/none.

cases.title: 导出失败后重试恢复
cases.honesty: Fault injection and source restore are harness (setup=failure). The script only waits for Retry failed and taps it. A replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: Android 崩溃恢复入口

reason.ios: map.yaml ios.drive is none; crash-count recovery gate is Android-only.

cases.honesty: Harness injects the crash-count gate. Script taps Turn off recovery mode / 关闭恢复模式 only. Never clear app data.

cases.title: iOS 相册读取引导

reason.android: Library Read upsell is iOS-only (map.yaml android.drive is none).

cases.honesty: supported true on iOS for the in-app Faster previews overlay. PHPicker cells and the system Photos permission dialog remain seam. Do not claim those as real. setup=ios revokes Library Read; it does not clear app state.

cases.title: 宽屏双栏与编辑状态

reason.android: editorLayoutExpanded is a testTag; Android snapshots do not expose it as id/label/role, and width change is harness-only.
reason.ios: Default agent target is iPhone; dual-pane needs iPad width >= 800pt. Phone sim cannot morph.

cases.honesty: Scripts wait editor landmarks only. Size/density changes are harness, not agent. A phone screenshot is not dual-pane evidence.

cases.title: 把平铺改成单个（CLAMP）
cases.honesty: In-app Style tile chips. Locale: Repeat/Single or 重复/单个. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 在样式里改字体或描边
cases.honesty: In-app Style typeface chips. Locale: Bold or 粗体. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 在胶片条上切换当前照片
cases.honesty: Needs two photos from editor setup. Hard-cut filmstrip; no export. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 开关从照片取编辑器主题
cases.honesty: About switch Theme editor from photo. Untranslated zh may still be English. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 开关使用应用内图库

reason.ios: map.yaml ios.drive is none; in-app gallery preference is Android-only.

cases.honesty: Android-only About switch. iOS drive none. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 导出格式 JPEG/PNG 切换
cases.honesty: Export sheet JPEG/PNG chips. Quality row stays composed when PNG. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 从关于打开开源许可
cases.honesty: About row Open source licenses / 开源许可. Overlay Back returns to About. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 开关跟随壁纸取色

reason.ios: map.yaml ios.drive is none; wallpaper Material You is Android-only.

cases.honesty: Android-only About switch Follow wallpaper colors. Untranslated zh may still be English. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 开关显示边界
cases.honesty: About switch Show Bounds. Untranslated zh may still be English. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 拖动单个水印
cases.honesty: Switches Style tile to Single then taps the preview. Offset delta is L1-proven; a tap without pan is not a product fail. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 取消正在导出
cases.honesty: Cancel export is composed only while exporting. A fast export that skips the control is REPLAY_DIVERGENCE, not a UI-quality fail. Replay pass is not a product pass.

cases.title: 改文字大小颜色透明度后导出
cases.honesty: One editor session: text fill, Style size/color/alpha, then PNG export. Slider taps hit sliderTrack center. Queuing separate map edges is not this journey — each edge re-applies setup. Replay pass is not a product pass.
